caveats: ⚑ S1 trigger substituted: the kit fires Revenge on 'attacked 20 time(s)'. The sim models no incoming boss damage, so the activation is unobservable and is encoded as interval 20 s (first fire t=20 s). Revenge is therefore continuously up from t=20 s and absent before it — a pure modeling convention, not a measurement.

⚑ Burst rider is UNGATED: the kit gates the second 457.87% hit on 'Revenge status', and the effect schema has no self-status gate (requiresTargetStatus is an enemy-status channel). Modeled at an assumed ~100% Revenge uptime, which OVER-CREDITS any burst cast before Revenge first procs.
⚑ S2 cadence invented: the kit prose carries no activation clause and no cooldown, so both S2 sub-lines are keyed to one interval (30 s estimate) with the stated 10 s durations.

Taunt (all enemies, 10 s) is unmodeled — there is no aggro model and the v1 boss deals no damage — but it is the real-game driver of S1's hit count, so the ⚑ Revenge cadence above stands on an unmodeled line.
Burst-cast damage is FB-exempt by TIMING (the cast lands before the Full Burst window opens); noFb is deliberately NOT set on either hit (measured-only field, default OFF).

Both burst hits are crit-eligible at the caster's sheet rate and carry NO core (the kit text does not say 'core strike damage'). This matters more than usual here because S2 grants +152.84% Critical Damage to self.

⚑ Base weapon economy (9 ammo, reloadFrames 142, 10 pellets/shot, SG cadence) comes from the datamine, which is unreliable for rate_of_fire/reloadFrames; shots fired — and therefore total normal-attack damage — inherit that uncertainty.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Maiden — SG/Electric/Attacker/Burst III, 9 ammo, 10 hits/shot, normal 231.6% / core 200%. S1 Revenge = self ATK ▲26.66% for 20 s; the kit trigger is 'attacked 20 time(s)', which the engine cannot observe (no incoming boss damage is modeled), so it is encoded as ⚑ interval 20 s — first fire t=20 s, then continuously refreshed. S2 has two sub-lines under one activation: an all-enemy Taunt (10 s), unmodeled (no aggro model, boss deals no damage), and a self Critical Damage ▲152.84% for 10 s, keyed to a ⚑ interval 30 s because the kit prose states no cooldown. Burst = two separate 457.87%-of-final-ATK hits at burst-cast; the second is kit-gated on Revenge status, and since the schema has no self-status gate it is modeled UNGATED under an assumed ~100% Revenge uptime (⚑) — this over-credits any burst that fires before Revenge first procs. Both burst hits crit at the caster's sheet rate, take no core, and are Full-Burst-exempt by cast timing (noFb is not set).

audit.effectOrReason: Trigger SUBSTITUTED (⚑): incoming boss attacks are not modeled, so the hit-count activation is unobservable. Encoded as trigger {kind:'interval', sec:20} (first fire t=20 s) rather than dropped, because the burst's second 457.87% hit depends on Revenge status.
buff stat 'atkPct' value 26.66, durationSec 20, target self. Wall-clock seconds (not rounds); self-scoped per 'Affects self.'

No aggro/threat model in the sim and the v1 boss deals no damage, so a taunt moves nothing. NOT skipped as 'defensive' on principle — it is the real-game driver of S1's 20-hit count, which is why S1's cadence is a ⚑ estimate. Verbatim in unmodeled.skill2.

buff stat 'critDamagePct' value 152.84, durationSec 10, target self, on the same ⚑ interval-30 s activation as the taunt. Unscoped Critical Damage (the text names no normal-attack/charge scope), so it feeds normal hits and the crit-eligible burst riders alike.

flatDamage atkPct 457.87, crit true, target enemy, trigger burstCast. No core (text says no core strike); noRange left to the engine; noFb NOT set — burst-cast damage is FB-exempt by landing before the FB window.

Gate NOT enforced: the schema's only status gate (requiresTargetStatus) is an ENEMY-status channel opened by a targetStatus effect; Revenge is a self status with no primitive. Modeled as ~100% uptime (⚑, see caveats) instead of inventing a monotonic resource pool that could never express a lapse. This is a GATE on an implemented line, so it is recorded in caveats rather than unmodeled.

Second flatDamage atkPct 457.87, crit true, target enemy, trigger burstCast — authored as its OWN block (mirrors the second ■ header) so the Revenge gate can be attached later without touching the base hit.

flags.estimate: {kind:'interval', sec:20} — Revenge live continuously from t=20 s
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ class (2): a kit-stated activation the engine has no channel for. 'Attacked 20 time(s)' requires an incoming-damage model the sim does not have. S2's Taunt exists precisely to pull boss attacks onto Maiden, and Revenge lasts 20 s, so near-permanent uptime after an opening ramp is the realistic shape — but the RAMP LENGTH (how long 20 boss hits actually takes at scope lock, with and without the taunt window) is pure guesswork. A shorter true ramp under-credits the opening; a longer one over-credits it.
flags.recipe: From a scope-lock recording: timestamp the frame Maiden's Revenge buff icon first appears (and each re-application) relative to the 03:00→02:59 game-t0 frame; that first-appearance time IS the interval, and the gap between re-applications tests whether it holds continuously. Cross-check by counting boss attack instances (multi-hit attacks count per hit) to 20.

flags.estimate: Ungated — fires on every burst cast (assumed ~100% Revenge uptime)
flags.reasoning: The kit conditions the rider on Revenge status; no self-status gate exists in the schema. Under the ⚑ interval-20 s model above, Revenge is down only before t=20 s, so the only exposure is a burst cast inside the opening window — worth up to 457.87% of final ATK, i.e. HALF her burst, on that one cast. Encoding it via a never-decaying `resource` pool was rejected: it would fake precision it cannot back (no lapse semantics) and adds machinery the prose does not support.
flags.recipe: Read the burst popups on a recording: a Revenge-active burst should show TWO equal ~457.87%-scaled numbers, a Revenge-inactive burst ONE. If any real burst lands with Revenge down, add the gate (needs a self-status primitive, or condition the rider on the same trigger that lands Revenge).

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ class (2): the kit prose carries no activation clause and no cooldown, so per the no-'Activates when' convention it becomes an interval, first fire at t=CD. 30 s is a midpoint guess for a 10 s-window skill; the plausible range is 20–40 s and the choice swings the crit-damage uptime by ~2×, which lands directly on both burst riders and every normal shot.
flags.recipe: Read maiden's datamined skillCooldownsSec (data/) — that is a direct answer and outranks any estimate. Failing that, timestamp successive appearances of the Critical Damage buff icon / the taunt animation on a recording; the gap IS the cooldown.

flags.estimate: As datamined — 9 rounds, 142-frame reload, SG default cadence
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ class (1): rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields (a nominal rate is quantised to 60 fps frame boundaries, so effective ≠ nominal). Maiden carries no ammo/reload/fire-rate modifier of her own, so every one of her normal-attack shots rides directly on these three numbers.
flags.recipe: Count shots from the on-screen ammo counter over a fixed window on a scope-lock recording (the counter measures shots/sec directly), and time reload-start → first-shot for the reload figure; do NOT infer either from full-burst counts, which sit downstream of gauge.

flags.field: SG pellet handling (hitsPerShot 10) — engine-level, not an override field
flags.estimate: Engine default SG landing/consolidation; no override-side pellet config
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ class (5): split-vs-merge for a 10-pellet shot is kit-silent. Nothing in Maiden's prose modifies pellet count or consolidates pellets, so no `pelletCountFlat` or `consolidation` is authored — but her per-shot damage is fully exposed to whatever landing fraction / core rate the engine's SG geometry applies.
flags.recipe: Read damage popups on a Maiden recording: count distinct numbers per trigger pull (10 small vs fewer merged) and check the core/non-core split against the accuracy-circle geometry already in docs/data/sg-calc/. This is engine-side, not an override change.

flags.estimate: Not set (default OFF) — Full Burst applies by landing timing
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ class (6): noFb is measured-only and must never be set unmeasured. Maiden's burst damage is burst-cast damage, which by the established timing model lands BEFORE the Full Burst window opens and so takes no +50% anyway — the timing path, not a per-kit exemption flag, is what should produce that.
flags.recipe: If a recording ever shows a burst popup carrying the +50% Full Burst major, the timing model — not this override — is the thing to revisit; leave noFb unset until a measurement says otherwise.
